opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship (2027)

amount.raw: The 2026 scholarship was worth £6,000 plus a £1,000 replacement labour financial incentive; the 2027 amount is not stated on the page.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24; UK-based applicants; demonstratable interest in the relevant sector (2027 plans award three dairy and three pig scholarships).
opportunities.summary: An initiative to develop young talent in agriculture. Successful applicants undertake a 30-day study tour (June/July) staying on farms with Nuffield Scholars, after an induction day in London, building networks and future opportunities. Fully funded, including travel, subsistence and attendance at the Nuffield Conference, plus Nuffield Farming Associate membership. Applications open in November 2026.
